technical.lead: FMRB EO: classified-annex clock at day 3, first reply, T-4 to May 22
technical.body: The Frontier Model Review Board executive order entered its first full business day after the quiet weekend, with the ten-business-day classified-annex response clock running into its third calendar day. A Monday Lawfare procedural note reported that the Senate Cyber Subcommittee's classified-annex follow-up question set, transmitted Friday to the eight-witness slate, drew its first substantive Monday submission from NIST Director Locascio's office, with the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency Director's office and the remaining six witnesses confirming responses are in drafting against the deadline that now expires Friday May 22. A Monday Just Security analysis restated that the Friday unclassified summary memo's no-objection finding on the per-state attorney-general consultation pathway and the AISI cyber-evaluation reciprocity 120-day placement window leaves the classified-annex question set as the last open procedural gate, while White House OSTP held that the order remains in interagency review with no signing window before May 22. The House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee on Communications and Technology confirmed its parallel 30-day technical-review joint-resolution draft is now slated for a markup-scheduling decision in the new week.

technical.lead: Cerebras opens new week; sell-side holds $185-235 band on day-4 base
technical.body: Cerebras CBRS opened the new trading week with the market's first re-rating session for the four-consecutive-day consolidation base built into Friday's $198.60 close. A Monday BEAMSTART note reported the five-desk analyst spread carrying into the open unchanged from the weekend hold — Bernstein's $185 Market-Perform floor, Morgan Stanley's $192 target with the upside-scenario probability at 41 percent, Wells Fargo Securities Buy at $208, Jefferies Outperform at $225, and UBS Neutral at $205 — leaving the stock bracketed inside a roughly $185-to-$235 band as institutional desks reopened. Institutional-buyside cumulative net position held near 37 percent of float at the open. A Monday Datacenter Dynamics wire reported the Saudi Aramco Digital MoU close holding its late-Q2 2026 window and the Saudi PIF contingent-secondary discussion staying inside its 10-21 day execution window, with the desk preview cohort treating the Monday session as the resolution point for whether the consolidation base re-rates higher or holds flat into the May 21 Alphabet analyst day.

technical.lead: n8n CVE-2026-21858 day-18 scan falls to ~1,640; T-3 to deadline
technical.body: The Shadowserver day-eighteen n8n CVE-2026-21858 (Ni8mare) Monday scan recorded the descent resuming its steeper weekday slope as the May 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline reached T-minus-three business days. Internet-exposed pre-1.121.0 instances continued the descent to approximately 1,640 (down from Sunday's 1,920), with the US cohort easing to roughly 510 and the India cohort to approximately 270, and the residual long-tail unpatched share falling to about 12 percent as enterprise patch cycles resumed for the week. Censys honeypot telemetry reported exploitation attempts ticking back up to approximately 1.7x baseline at the Monday 09:00 UTC mark — consistent with commodity-tier exploit-kit volume returning to its weekday operating tempo after the weekend taper. CISA's Monday KEV-catalog note restated that the May 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline now sits at T-minus-three business days, and CSO Online reported that the CISA federal-civilian operational directive incorporating the eleven-CVE Trail of Bits agent-loader taxonomy, having cleared the OMB publication queue Friday, published Monday morning with a stated compliance window keyed to the eleven catalogued patterns.

technical.lead: Claude Code 3.0 day-11: ~31,050 skills, 66 gated tenants on 2 signings
technical.body: Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 day-eleven registry telemetry showed the second-week growth-rate normalization continuing as enterprise activity resumed for the business week. Anthropic's Monday operations note reported the sandboxed-skill registry counting roughly 31,050 published skills (up from 29,180 Sunday, about +6.4 percent — a fifth consecutive sub-7-percent reading), with approximately 2.74M skill installs across the eleventh 24 hours and auto-quarantined Mythos-class skills reaching 68. Anthropic reported the Mythos-Preview gated-tenant cohort adding two enterprise customers to reach 66 as the business week opened, the first signings since the weekend pause, with the new entrants in the Continental European public-sector tier. A Monday Simon Willison note documented that the open-source verification harness's deterministic per-tenant attestation-log audit trail continues to reproduce across all 66 gated tenants, with cross-tenant compositional safety checks holding under 55 seconds after the weekend's parallel-verification optimization — confirming the Verifiable Per-Tenant Capability Attestation paper's demonstration cycle scales cleanly as the gated cohort grows.

technical.lead: Monday arxiv 2605.07588 extends loader verification to training
technical.body: A Monday arxiv release (2605.07588) opened the research week by extending the weekend's loader-verification line from the agent-loader surface to the local-fine-tuning training surface, presenting a checkpoint-provenance verification model that carries the five-surface compositional safety guarantees through the LoRA and router-only training pipeline rather than only the inference-time loader. The paper, framed as a forward extension of the consolidated 2605.07241 framework and its 2605.07412 empirical companion rather than a fresh model, formalizes a signed-checkpoint provenance chain that binds a training run's intermediate checkpoints to the manifest-allowlist and intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization surfaces, and reports a reproduction study showing the provenance check adds a low single-digit-percentage overhead to a multi-GPU fine-tuning run. A Monday Simon Willison note characterized the paper as the loader-verification line moving upstream — extending the verified-reference plus measured-overhead pairing from agent cold-start into the training pipeline, and noting it gives local-fine-tuning stacks a citable provenance model that aligns with the framework cohort's mid-June default window. A Monday andrew.ooo reading observed the paper's reproduction harness is mirrored alongside the DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft consolidated reference-implementation index.
